title: U.S. House · Florida's 8th District
area: East-central Florida on the Space Coast, including Brevard County and Indian River County.

context.text: Both party primaries were canceled after only one candidate qualified in each: incumbent Republican Mike Haridopolos and Democrat Jennifer Jenkins advance directly to the November 3, 2026 general election.

candidates.name: Mike Haridopolos

summary.text: Mike Haridopolos is the Republican incumbent seeking re-election to Florida's 8th Congressional District. He previously served in the Florida House of Representatives and Florida Senate, including as Senate President, and is a college professor by profession.

background.text: Earned a B.A. from Stetson University in 1992, an M.A. from the University of Arkansas in 1993, and a Ph.D. from the University of Arkansas in 1999.
Worked as an author and college professor before and during his political career.
Served in the Florida House of Representatives (2000-2003) and the Florida State Senate (2003-2012), including as Senate President.
Elected to the U.S. House in 2024, succeeding Bill Posey; assumed office in January 2025.

record.text: Assigned to the Committee on Financial Services and the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology (as Chair of the Space and Aeronautics Subcommittee) for the 2025-2026 Congress.

candidates.researchNotes: Haridopolos has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey, and no additional public statements of his priorities or issue positions were found in the time available; only biographical and committee-assignment facts are included.

candidates.name: Jennifer Jenkins
candidates.currentRole: Former Brevard Public Schools school board member, District 3 (2020-2024)

summary.text: Jennifer Jenkins is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 8th Congressional District. She is a former Brevard Public Schools school board member who also briefly sought the 2026 U.S. Senate special election before running for this House seat.

background.text: Elected to the Brevard Public Schools school board, District 3, in 2020, defeating incumbent Tina Descovich; she did not seek re-election in 2024.
Also filed to run in the 2026 U.S. Senate special election in Florida before running for this U.S. House seat; she did not appear on the special Democratic primary ballot.

candidates.researchNotes: Jenkins has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey and her campaign website could not be loaded in the time available, so no sourced statements of her priorities or issue positions are included; only biographical facts and organizational endorsements (Democratic Environmental Caucus of Florida, Florida LGBTQ+ Democratic Caucus) are documented on Ballotpedia.
